Subject: Onboarding request — b7x-slim variant + temporary pin & rollback plan

Hi team,

Edge Labs has asked us to onboard their preferred variant b7x-slim (a 7B derivative with custom tokenizers/knobs) into Private for a pilot. They want a temporary version pin for the first 2 weeks to avoid automatic upgrades while they run evals.

Key asks:
- Compatibility check with our runtime (kernels + kv cache)
- A temporary pinning exception (2 weeks) with an automatic rollback plan
- Quick perf + safety smoke tests and a short risk memo for legal/security

I've attached our perf matrix from their initial eval and a draft pin-exception template. Can infra (Marcus) confirm whether there are any known opcode/kernel issues with b7x-slim? Product (Lauren) — please confirm acceptance criteria for the pilot. Security (Stephanie) — what minimum artifacts do you need to clear this?

Proposed timeline: compat checks by EOD 13 Jan, sign-off 14 Jan, pilot launch w/c 19 Jan.

Thanks,
Dev

--
Dev Patel
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onboarding request — b7x-slim variant + temporary pin & rollback plan

Thanks Dev — quick responses below.

Acceptance criteria for the pilot:
- End-to-end latency within 1.5x of current 7B baseline for 512 tokens
- No more than 2% increase in token error (mismatch in logits leading to dev-visible drift) on our regression prompts
- All safety filters pass on a 200-prompt smoke set

Can we also add a simple telemetry dashboard to track token-level cost and top-5 hallucination triggers? If Marcus flags a kernel change that requires a new build, we should include a rollback window and a canary route.

If Edge needs a pin, I'd prefer to limit to 10 business days with automated removal unless product signs off for extension. Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Product Manager, Model Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, benji@edge-labs.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding request — b7x-slim variant + temporary pin & rollback plan

Quick infra assessment after running the sample model bundle Edge provided:

Findings:
- b7x-slim uses a custom attention kernel that works with our FP16 path but regresses on continuous batching for short sequences — expected ~10-20% throughput loss for <=64 tokens.
- KV cache layout is compatible, but we found a tokenization edge case (split-on-unicode) that can increase decode variance; easy fix in the tokenizer shim.
- No kernel crashes; however, one op uses an unsupported fused matmul variant on older Nvidia driver (470.x) — we'll need a fallback code path or require updated drivers on Dedicated/Private nodes.

Work plan (estimated):
- Today: run full perf sweep against our 512/2048 traces (will post results)
- 13 Jan EOD: provide a short risk matrix and required infra changes
- If we need a build change, plan a canary rollout and provide a rollback image tagged immutable.

On pinning: technically we can create a temporary pin policy (10 business days) with automatic expiry and a forced rollback image if any regression alarms trigger. I'll prepare the pin-exception artifact and a rollback playbook.

Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Security/Compliance checklist (minimum) for a Private pilot:
- Model provenance doc from Edge (weights provenance + training data high level)
- Threat model & safety eval on the pilot prompt set (I need the 200 prompts)
- Encryption-at-rest confirmation for their bundle and key access constraints (KMS info)
- SOC2/ISO attachments for Edge (if available)

If we allow a pin exception, we should add stricter audit logging for the pinned model (token sampling logs masked for PII) and require approval from Legal for any retention beyond 30 days.

I can sign off on the pilot once we have the provenance doc, our eval results, and the KMS confirmation.

Stephanie

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Folks — thanks for the fast responses and for the tests so far. Action items summary and owners:

- Marcus: post the perf sweep CSV and the driver compatibility note (target: EOD 14 Jan).
- Lauren: confirm telemetry + acceptance dashboard fields (target: 14 Jan).
- Stephanie: list exact artifacts required for sign-off and the minimum audit logging configuration (target: 14 Jan).
- Edge (Benji): please upload the model provenance doc and KMS details to the Drive link (I've shared the folder).

Decision: we will move forward with a 10-business-day pin with automatic expiry. If any regression alarm trips (latency > 1.5x baseline or safety regression > 2%), we will trigger the rollback image Marcus will produce. Product to own extension requests.

Please reply-all with a one-line ack when you have your item complete so I can compile the sign-off packet for Legal.

Thanks,
Dev
